name: Point of Sale
description: Full POS order screen: customer search with price list & balance, item lines with barcode/BOGO, discounts & tax, payments, stock check, customer history, print, email PDF and draft save.

fields.label: Customer
fields.pickerSql: SELECT ACCOUNT_NAME, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, CITY, PRICE_LIST, STATUS, HOLD_STATUS, PHONE, EMAIL_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_TERM FROM GRFU_CUSTOMER WHERE UPPER(ACCOUNT_NAME) LIKE :SEARCH OR UPPER(ACCOUNT_NUMBER) LIKE :SEARCH OR UPPER(PHONE) LIKE :SEARCH ORDER BY ACCOUNT_NAME FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
fields.hint: Search by name, account number or phone

fields.label: Order Type
fields.listSql: SELECT ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS VALUE, ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS LABEL FROM FUSION_ORDER_TYPES ORDER BY ORDER_TYPE_CODE

fields.label: Shop / Location
fields.listSql: SELECT SHOP_CODE AS VALUE, SHOP_NAME AS LABEL FROM SHOP_LOCATION_MAPPING ORDER BY SHOP_NAME

fields.label: Currency
fields.listSql: SELECT DISTINCT CURRENCY_CODE AS VALUE, CURRENCY_CODE AS LABEL FROM FUSION_PRICE_LIST WHERE CURRENCY_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

fields.label: Salesrep
fields.listSql: SELECT SALESREP_NUMBER AS VALUE, SALESREP_NUMBER || ' - ' || NAME AS LABEL FROM SALESREP_REF ORDER BY NAME

fields.label: Sales Agent
fields.listSql: SELECT AGENT_NAME AS VALUE, AGENT_NAME AS LABEL FROM POS_AGENTS WHERE SALESREP_NUMBER = :SALESREP ORDER BY AGENT_NAME

fields.label: Credit Limit
fields.valueSql: SELECT CREDIT_LIMIT AS VALUE FROM FUSION_CUSTOMER_BALANCE WHERE ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :CUSTOMER_NUMBER FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

fields.label: AR Balance
fields.valueSql: SELECT AMT_REMAINING AS VALUE FROM FUSION_CUSTOMER_BALANCE WHERE ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :CUSTOMER_NUMBER FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

fields.label: Item to check
fields.pickerSql: SELECT ITEM_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, BARCODE FROM GRFU_ITEM WHERE UPPER(ITEM_NUMBER) LIKE :SEARCH OR UPPER(DESCRIPTION) LIKE :SEARCH OR BARCODE LIKE :SEARCH FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
fields.hint: Pick an item, then run the On-hand report below

details.title: Items
details.pickerSql: SELECT ITEM_NUMBER AS ITEM_CODE, ITEM_DESC, BASE_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, TAX_CODE, NVL(TAX_RATE,0) AS TAX_RATE, PRICING_UOM_CODE AS UOM, BARCODE FROM GRFU_PRICELIST_VW WHERE LIST_NAME = :PRICE_LIST AND (UPPER(ITEM_NUMBER) LIKE :SEARCH OR UPPER(ITEM_DESC) LIKE :SEARCH OR BARCODE LIKE :SEARCH) ORDER BY ITEM_DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

columns.label: Item / Barcode
columns.lookupSql: SELECT ITEM_NUMBER AS ITEM_CODE, ITEM_DESC, BASE_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, TAX_CODE, NVL(TAX_RATE,0) AS TAX_RATE, PRICING_UOM_CODE AS UOM, BARCODE FROM GRFU_PRICELIST_VW WHERE LIST_NAME = :PRICE_LIST AND (UPPER(ITEM_NUMBER) = UPPER(:ITEM_CODE) OR BARCODE = :ITEM_CODE) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

details.lineRulesSql: SELECT PROMOITEMCODE AS ITEM_CODE, PROMOITEMDESC AS ITEM_DESC, GETQTY AS QTY, NVL(PROMOPRICE,0) AS LIST_PRICE, VATCODE AS TAX_CODE, 0 AS DISC_PCT FROM FUSION_BOGO_ITEMS WHERE UPPER(MAINITEMCODE) = UPPER(:ITEM_CODE) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN NVL(STARTDATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(ENDDATE, TRUNC(SYSDATE))

details.title: Payments
details.pickerSql: SELECT PAYMENT_MODE, REFERENCE_REQUIRED FROM FUSION_AR_RECEIPT_METHODS WHERE UPPER(PAYMENT_MODE) LIKE :SEARCH ORDER BY PAYMENT_MODE FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

columns.label: Payment Mode
columns.lookupSql: SELECT PAYMENT_MODE, REFERENCE_REQUIRED FROM FUSION_AR_RECEIPT_METHODS WHERE UPPER(PAYMENT_MODE) = UPPER(:PAYMENT_MODE) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

reports.title: On-hand Stock (selected item)
reports.sql: SELECT ORGANIZATION_CODE, SUBINVENTORY_CODE, ITEM_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, LOT_NUMBER, TRANSACTION_QUANTITY AS QTY, TRANSACTION_UOM_CODE AS UOM FROM GRFU_ONHAND_VW WHERE UPPER(ITEM_NUMBER) = UPPER(:STOCK_ITEM) ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_CODE, SUBINVENTORY_CODE, LOT_NUMBER FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY

reports.title: Customer Order History (last 50)
reports.sql: SELECT SOURCE_ORDER_NUMBER, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_TYPE, LOCATION, TOTAL_GROSS, TOTAL_DISCOUNT, TOTAL_TAX, TOTAL_NET, ORDER_STATUS FROM ORDER_CART_HEADER WHERE BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NUMBER = :CUSTOMER_NUMBER ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

reports.title: Customer Receipts (last 30)
reports.sql: SELECT RECEIPT_DATE, RECEIPT_NUMBER, RECEIPT_AMOUNT, RECEIPT_CURRENCY, RECEIPT_PAYMENT_MODE, REFERENCE_NUMBER FROM FUSION_AR_RECEIPTS WHERE CUSTOMER_NUMBER = :CUSTOMER_NUMBER ORDER BY RECEIPT_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

submitChecks.message: Select a valid customer from the customer master.
Customer is inactive or on hold - order cannot be created.
submitChecks.sql: SELECT 1 FROM GRFU_CUSTOMER WHERE ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :CUSTOMER_NUMBER AND (UPPER(STATUS) IN ('I','INACTIVE') OR UPPER(HOLD_STATUS) IN ('Y','HOLD','ON HOLD'))

submitChecks.message: Order type is not a valid Fusion order type.
The customer's price list has no items - check the price list.
submitChecks.sql: SELECT 1 FROM GRFU_PRICELIST_VW WHERE LIST_NAME = :PRICE_LIST FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

actions.label: Create Order
actions.prompt: Create this POS order in the WMS DB (order.create flow) from the reviewed form values: header, item lines (item, qty, list, disc%, tax) and payments. Customer {customer_number} - {customer_name}, price list {price_list}, order type {order_type}, shop {location}, salesrep {salesrep}, agent {agent_name}, cashier {cashier}. Validate every item against price list {price_list}, show the plan with totals, then create it.

actions.label: Email PDF
actions.prompt: Produce a clean PDF of this POS order (header, item lines with totals, payments) and email it to {email} for customer {customer_number} - {customer_name}, subject 'Your order confirmation'. Use the Office 365 email settings already configured.

actions.label: Stock Check
actions.prompt: Check on-hand stock (GRFU_ONHAND_VW) for every item on this POS order's lines and flag any line whose quantity exceeds available stock.

actions.label: History
actions.prompt: Show the order history of customer {customer_number} - {customer_name}: last 50 orders from ORDER_CART_HEADER with number, date, type, location, net and status, plus the balance from FUSION_CUSTOMER_BALANCE.

items.label: Email
items.tooltip: Email the order as a PDF
